findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_account, list_flows, list_transactions, list_entity_settlements, get_agent, get_merchant, run_sql · Private data: get_account, list_flows, list_transactions, list_entity_settlements, get_agent, get_merchant, list_agents, list_wallets, get_leaderboard, list_agent_feedback, list_facilitators, get_graph, list_services, list_capabilities, get_capability, recommend_capability_offers, run_sql · Public sink: list_capabilities, run_sql · Destructive: run_sql.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_account, list_flows, list_transactions, list_entity_settlements, get_agent, get_merchant, run_sql · Private data: get_account, list_flows, list_transactions, list_entity_settlements, get_agent, get_merchant, list_agents, list_wallets, get_leaderboard, list_agent_feedback, list_facilitators, get_graph, list_services, list_capabilities, get_capability, recommend_capability_offers, run_sql · Public sink: list_capabilities, run_sql · Destructive: run_sql

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
